name: Aether
runtime: native WebView2 window (pywebview) — localhost only, no browser UI

context.yarn_note: Qwen3-Coder supports YaRN to 1M in theory, but Ollama does not expose YaRN rope scaling. 1M is not practical on a 3090 Ti (24GB); use llama.cpp directly if you ever need it on much larger memory.

ollama_tuning.note: Unified memory is ON by default on Windows (WDDM). Linux needs GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY=1 on the ollama systemd unit so extra KV/context pages into RAM instead of OOM.
